needed.evidence: No designated footway for pedestrians on the left side of the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are using an unpaved, informal dirt path rather than a purpose-built sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Pave and formalise the informal path on the right side to provide a safe, all-weather footway.

needed.evidence: Pedestrian demand is evident from the presence of a pedestrian and commercial signs, but there is no designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing to provide pedestrians with a safe and visible point to cross the road.

needed.evidence: The road is in an urban area with commercial activity but has no visible street lighting.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road segment to improve visibility and safety for all users at night.
